satisfaction_criteria.criterion: Each execution outcome has deterministic status and reason semantics.
Retries and resumed runs preserve task_id and append evidence history.
Stale input and cancellation prevent dependents from becoming ready until an explicit valid recovery occurs.
Redelivered execution attempts for the same logical work unit are deduplicated or recorded as duplicate attempts without changing task_id or forking terminal outcome semantics.

residuality_facet.proof_boundary: Discovery until W4 duplicate-delivery composition fault

satisfaction_criteria.criterion: After unknown completion, retry/resume preserves task_id and does not append conflicting terminal evidence.

residuality_facet.proof_boundary: Discovery until W4 unknown-outcome composition fault

satisfaction_criteria.criterion: Dependency satisfaction evaluates completion order and terminal status — message or queue delivery order alone must not unlock dependents when predecessor remains failed or non-terminal.

residuality_facet.proof_boundary: Discovery until W4 out-of-order completion composition fault

satisfaction_criteria.criterion: After bounded retries are exhausted, task reaches a terminal failed state with stable reason code; dependents remain locked; evidence history is inspectable for operator action.

residuality_facet.proof_boundary: Discovery until W4 max-retry terminal composition fault

satisfaction_criteria.criterion: Store persistence failures surface as explicit non-success outcomes with deterministic reason — tasks are not marked successful when evidence or state writes fail.

residuality_facet.proof_boundary: Discovery until W4 store-write-failure composition fault

satisfaction_criteria.criterion: A reused request key with different normalized input returns a deterministic collision error.
Concurrent creators serialize allocation and never publish partial manifests.
The same request key and normalized request return the existing feature without a second allocation.
Redelivered create requests with the same normalized request key do not allocate a second feature or publish a second manifest.

residuality_facet.proof_boundary: Discovery until W4 duplicate-delivery composition fault

satisfaction_criteria.criterion: After an unknown outcome (timeout or ambiguous response), a retry with the same request key returns the same feature reference or a deterministic in-progress state — never a second allocation.

residuality_facet.proof_boundary: Discovery until W4 unknown-outcome composition fault

satisfaction_criteria.criterion: Expired allocation locks release per documented TTL; subsequent creators proceed only when store metadata confirms prior lock is invalid — stale lock holders cannot block past TTL.

residuality_facet.proof_boundary: Discovery until W4 lock-TTL composition fault
